hook.say: Balloons, fairy chimneys and cities hidden underground. Five questions on Cappadocia. Ready?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What fills the sky over Cappadocia at sunrise?
questions.say: What fills the sky over Cappadocia at sunrise?
questions.fact: Balloons drift over the valleys around Göreme at dawn.
questions.sayAnswer: Hot-air balloons! They drift over the valleys around Guh-reh-meh at dawn.

questions.q: What are Cappadocia's tall rock spires called?
questions.say: What are Cappadocia's tall rock spires called?
questions.fact: Wind and water carved them from soft volcanic rock.
questions.sayAnswer: Fairy chimneys! Wind and water carved them from soft volcanic rock.

questions.q: Göreme, the heart of Cappadocia, is in which province?
questions.say: Guh-reh-meh, the heart of Cappadocia, is in which province?
questions.fact: Göreme National Park has been a UNESCO site since 1985.
questions.sayAnswer: Nev-sheh-heer! Guh-reh-meh National Park has been a UNESCO site since 1985.

questions.q: Cappadocia's soft rock was laid down by what?
questions.say: Cappadocia's soft rock was laid down by what?
questions.fact: Erciyes, Hasan and Göllüdağ volcanoes blanketed the region.
questions.sayAnswer: Volcanic eruptions! Three ancient volcanoes, including Mount Air-jee-yes, blanketed the region.

questions.q: About how many people could Derinkuyu underground city shelter?
questions.say: About how many people could Deh-rin-koo-yoo underground city shelter?
questions.fact: Derinkuyu goes down about 85 metres below the surface.
questions.sayAnswer: Twenty thousand! The city goes down about 85 meters below the surface.
